 Order
Heard the learned Senior counsel Sri K.Arun Kumar appearing on behalf of Sri Amshuman.M for the petitioner.
2. Learned Additional Government Advocate accepts notice for the respondents.
3. The petitioner is a Society running several educational institutions.

The case of the petitioner is, it was accorded permission to carry out pre-primary, primary school since 2019 by name ORCHIDS THE INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL which was renewed from time to time on regular basis through the application for renewal.

4. The petitioner is before this Court questioning the inaction of respondent Nos.1 to 5 in not taking action on the application dated 19.09.2022 made by the petitioner's institution and NOC which was sought for by the petitioner's institution has not been provided or accorded by the respondents despite the application having made in the month of September 2022.

5. There are several allegations made against the respondents for non-consideration of the application and the respondents harassing the petitioner's institution including initiation of the criminal complaint under Section 420 and Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

6. It is contended that non-consideration of the application for recognition is violation of principles of natural justice and the respondents are causing harassment to the petitioner's institution in imparting education to the students of the schools.

7. Per contra, learned Additional Government Advocate representing the respondents contends that the petitioner has made an application seeking affiliation for CBSE and NOC for the academic year 2022-2023 in September 2022 and they would consider the application of the petitioner's institution as per the Rules and Regulations.

It is further submitted by the learned Additional Government Advocate, on instructions, that the South DDPI has received the application just two days back and the North DDPI has received the application last two weeks and they have called for certain documents from the petitioner's institution which are yet to be submitted.

8. Be that as it may, it is submitted across the Bar that the School as of now functioning without any hindrance but awaiting NOC from the respondent-State.

sentences.text: In view of the application having been made during September 2022 by the petitioner's institution, the respondents-State is duty bound to reply/answer and consider the application which is pending before it since 19.09.2022 and they cannot sleep over on the application presented by the petitioner for consideration of NOC and affiliation for CBSE.
10. The learned Senior counsel submits that the time the time period for filing the application for affiliation for CBSE closes during the second week of March 2023.

It is also submitted that he would not press prayer (B) and restricts to prayer (A) sought for in the writ petition i.e., to consider the application dated 19.09.2022.
11.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) Writ petition is allowed in part.
ii) A writ of mandamus is issued to respondent Nos.1 to 5 to consider the application dated 19.09.2022 filed by the petitioner's institution with regard to affiliation and issuance of NOC.
The same shall be expeditiously considered on or before 03.03.2023.

iii) It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion with regard to prayer (b) on initiation of criminal proceedings against the petitioner institution under Section 420 and Section 34 of Indian Penal Code and the same is left open.
Sd/-
